question: When I cloak a shuffled face-down pile of two cards, can I look at them after they are cloaked?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: after you cloak the cards you may look at them.
expected.answer: The pile is shuffled to disguise from your opponents which card is which. After you cloak the cards, you may look at them.

whyHard: The shuffle hides which card is which from opponents, and players assume it hides it from you too.
